svg.title: APEX 11 — Demonstrate the right thing to the right person
svg.text: Demonstrate the right thing to the right person
A demonstration is not a product tour. It follows five steps, is tailored to one persona, shows only live capabilities that
answer that persona’s problem, ends on one proof point and one next step, and uses the built-in demo modes with

g.text: roles, audit log, proxied storage, AI
Use demo modes or a clean environment; label sample data as illustrative.
Show only LIVE features as working; present roadmap items as roadmap.
Open with the persona’s problem; end with one clear next step.
Never quote customer results or ROI until a pilot report exists.

svg.text: Short for executives, deep for operations and technology, hands-on for users and partners. A demo succeeds when
the persona agrees a dated next step — a sponsor, pilot teams, a champion, technical sign-off or a partner talk.
Capability status shown on the poster where relevant
Readiness: capabilities marked LIVE are built and tested; none is yet proven in a customer production environment. No customer results, ROI, certifications or prices are claimed.
November 2026 · Internal sales enablement · A0 841 × 1189 mm
